skills.name: hud
skills.description: Initialize, configure, validate, preview, modify, migrate, extend, uninstall, and troubleshoot Statusline HUD (statusline-hud) for Antigravity CLI. Use when the user invokes /hud or asks in natural language to set up, check, customize, togg

readmeMarkdown:
Statusline HUD

English | 简体中文

A multi-line terminal statusline and interactive /hud plugin for Antigravity CLI (agy).

> [!NOTE] > Targets **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)** on Linux, macOS, and WSL. Desktop app sessions and IDE extensions do not render custom TUI status lines. ![Statusline HUD preview](./assets/example.png) ## Quick Start Requires `agy`, `bash` 3.2+, `jq` 1.6+, and optional `git`. 1. **Install the plugin** ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/linbo0518/antigravity-hud ``` 2. **Enable and customize** Launch `agy` and run **`/hud`**—it checks your setup, previews the bar, and walks you through enabling and customizing. Or activate directly with: ```text /statusline ~/.gemini/config/plugins/statusline-hud/scripts/statusline.sh ``` Re-run `agy plugin install ...` anytime to upgrade; your preferences are preserved automatically. ## Using `/hud` Everything is handled through `/hud` or plain natural language inside `agy`—no config files to memorize: - `/hud` — check setup, preview the layout, and toggle modules - `/hud setup` / `/hud uninstall` — guide enabling the statusline or safely uninstall - `/hud hide title` / `/hud show title` — hide or show any module (changes take effect immediately) - `/hud hide cost in split panes` — override modules only for narrow panes (`<100` cols) - `/hud check` — diagnose setup, config, or display issues - `/hud reset` — restore all defaults ## Symbols - **Git**: `[...]` status flags (`=` conflicted, `+` staged, `!` modified, `✘` deleted, `»` renamed, `?` untracked, `$` stashed, `↑N`/`↓N` ahead/behind) and `(+N −M)` tracked diff lines; narrow panes show `*` when dirty. - **Quota**: used % (green `<60%`, yellow `60–89%`, red `>=90%`) + reset time; count-only buckets show ` left`. - **Tokens**: `tok (↑ ↓)` across the session (including subagents), followed by ` tok/s` for the main agent's current-turn output rate. - **Model**: in Orchestrator mode, shows `Orchestrator: → ` read from agy's `settings.json` (the statusline payload omits them), i.e. the last saved selection. ## Uninstall Revert the statusline **before** removing the plugin: 1. In `agy`, run `/statusline delete`. 2. In your shell, run: ```bash agy plugin uninstall statusline-hud rm -rf "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/statusline-hud" "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/statusline-hud" # optional ```
Advanced: manual config.json, standalone install & development ### Manual `config.json` Stored at `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/statusline-hud/config.json` (hot-reloads automatically): | Row | Switches (left to right) | | --- | --- | | 1 | `showMode`, `showModel`, `showContext`, `showPath`, `showGit` | | 2 | `showGeminiQuota`, `show3pQuota` | | 3 | `showArtifacts`, `showSubagents`, `showTasks`, `showSandbox`, `showTokens`, `showTokenSpeed`, `showCache`, `showDuration`, `showCost`, `showTitle` | Core status always starts row 1. All switches are booleans defaulting to `true`; enabled count and state items (`context`, `artifacts`, `subagents`, `tasks`, `sandbox`, `tokens`, `token speed`, `duration`) show `0`, `0.0%`, `0 tok/s`, `0m`, or `OFF` even when omitted by the CLI, while items with no value (such as an untitled session, non-Git path, or unreported quota/cache/cost) and empty rows are omitted. Below 100 columns, `narrow` overrides apply (missing keys inherit) and compact text forms are used; long rows may wrap. ```json { "showTitle": false, "showCost": false, "narrow": { "showCost": true } } ``` ### Standalone single-script install (without `/hud`) ```bash cp scripts/statusline.sh ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/statusline.sh chmod +x ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/statusline.sh ``` Then run `/statusline ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/statusline.sh` inside `agy`. ### Development & validation ```bash ./tests/test.sh agy plugin validate --strict . ```
## Acknowledgments - **[claude-hud](https://github.com/jarrodwatts/claude-hud)** by Jarrod Watts (MIT License) — multi-line HUD hierarchy and `/hud` workflow inspiration. - **[Google Antigravity CLI `statusline` example](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/tree/main/examples/statusline)** — 16-color palette and status payload reference. ## License [MIT](./LICENSE)

findings.snippet: - Run the script directly with a sample payload to inspect raw output and exit status: `printf '{"agent_state":"working","terminal_width":120}' | <statusline-path>`.
